info.title: SouthLeaf Admin API
info.description: Same-origin administrative contract: login/session plus the stage-two booking and notification surfaces. Confirm and reject are both explicit operator decisions about a pending request; only confirm can occupy a slot and create an order, and nothing in this contract charges, refunds or deposits money.

servers.description: Same-origin HTTPS deployment only; the host and scheme are not client supplied.

get.summary: Obtain the current same-origin CSRF token

200.description: CSRF token issued or returned; Cache-Control is no-store.

Set-Cookie.description: Secure __Host-sl_admin_csrf cookie; not an authentication cookie.

post.summary: Authenticate a staff account and issue a secure session cookie

200.description: Authenticated current identity. The raw session token is only in Set-Cookie; the JSON body never contains it.

Set-Cookie.description: New __Host-sl_admin_session cookie with Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and Path=/; CSRF state is rotated.

get.summary: Read the current staff identity from its authoritative server session

post.summary: Revoke the current staff session before clearing cookies

204.description: Session revocation completed or no valid session existed; secure session and CSRF cookies are cleared.

Set-Cookie.description: Clears the same cookie names/path/security attributes using Max-Age=0.

get.summary: List pending requests awaiting an explicit operator review
get.description: Q02: a request never occupies a slot by itself. Only this list plus an explicit confirm can turn a request into an order. Bounded to the most recent 100 rows.

get.summary: Read one reservation with its assignments and current order reference

200.description: Reservation detail. The ETag is the revision to present on any write.

ETag.description: Opaque reservation revision validator, for example "r2"; send it back as If-Match.

get.summary: List open slots inside a UTC range

200.description: Open, unoccupied slots with capacity left, bounded to 100 rows.

get.summary: Read one order with its immutable snapshot and append-only revisions

200.description: Order detail. There is no payment, deposit or delivery field anywhere in this contract.

post.summary: Confirm a pending request: occupy the slot, create the unique order and its immutable snapshot
post.description: One transaction: occupancy -> reservation -> order -> snapshot -> audit -> outbox. The slot is named by the operator, so no request can occupy a slot by itself. The price is read from the immutable package fact; a missing fact fails with PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND semantics rather than a guessed amount. Replaying the same Idempotency-Key returns the same order instead of creating a second one.

200.description: Confirmed. The new ETag is the reservation revision after the write.

ETag.description: Opaque reservation revision validator, for example "r2"; send it back as If-Match.

post.summary: Cancel a reservation, release occupancy and append an order revision

200.description: Cancelled. No refund or payment step exists in this contract.

ETag.description: Opaque reservation revision validator, for example "r2"; send it back as If-Match.

post.summary: Move a reservation to another slot inside one transaction

200.description: Rescheduled. The previous occupancy is released and the snapshot is unchanged.

ETag.description: Opaque reservation revision validator, for example "r2"; send it back as If-Match.

get.description: Delivery is lease-and-retry, never exactly-once. This board only exposes failures that an operator may recover manually.

200.description: Delivery mode, pending count and dead letters.

post.summary: Requeue a dead letter after an explicit operator review

200.description: The recovery was recorded as a command and the message is queued again.

post.summary: Refuse a pending request without occupying a slot or creating an order
post.description: The other answer to the same pending question. A rejection only closes the request: no occupancy, no order, no snapshot. It is audited and enqueues a RESERVATION_REJECTED notification, so the decision is recorded rather than silently dropped. The body must not name a slot.

200.description: Rejected. orderId and slotId are null because neither exists for a refusal.

ETag.description: Opaque reservation revision validator after the write.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must exactly equal the server-configured public admin origin.

CsrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
CsrfHeader.description: Value obtained from GET /auth/csrf; never persist it.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The reservation revision last read, for example "r2". A missing value is 428, a stale one is 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key scoped to the actor and operation. Replaying it returns the stored result instead of a second side effect.

RecoveryReason.name: X-Recovery-Reason
RecoveryReason.description: Operator-supplied reason code written into the audit record.

RequestId.description: Server-generated request correlation identifier; not an authentication or business identifier.

Snapshot.description: Written once at confirmation and never updated; a correction is a new revision, not an edit.

InvalidRequest.description: Malformed or disallowed request; no credential verification ran.

InvalidCredentials.description: Uniform credential/account-state failure; never reveals account existence.

OriginOrCsrfRejected.description: Same-origin browser safeguard rejected before protected work.

AlreadyAuthenticated.description: A valid session cookie already exists; callers must not silently switch identities.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Only application/json is accepted for writes.

AuthUnavailable.description: Authentication dependency, audit, database or KDF service unavailable; it is not represented as a credential error or confirmed logout.

Forbidden.description: The current identity lacks the capability this route requires.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to this identity; the two cases are deliberately indistinguishable.

Conflict.description: Version conflict, slot already unavailable, or an idempotency key reused with a different body.

BookingBodyTooLarge.description: Booking writes are bounded to 1 KiB.

PreconditionRequired.description: If-Match, If-Match format or Idempotency-Key was missing, so no write ran.

BookingUnavailable.description: Booking or notification storage is unavailable; the caller must not treat this as a business outcome.
